summary: Frontend regression test on Admin Rooms + Reservations modals after claimed scroll/save fix. Core save/edit round-trip WORKS at 1280x720. However, the CSS scroll fix described in the problem statement was NOT actually applied to DialogContent - modals still have overflowY:visible and maxHeight:none, so at viewport heights <=700px the Salvar button falls below the viewport and cannot be reached.

ui_bugs.issue: Claimed fix 'max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' was NOT applied. DialogContent still has only 'max-w-2xl'. Measured at 1280x600: dialog height=740, top=-70, bottom=670, viewport=600, Save button at y=609-645 (off-screen), overflowY=visible, maxHeight=none, scrollHeight==clientHeight (no internal scroll). At 1280x720 it happens to fit only because content is 738px (Save at bottom=705, viewport=720) - reachable but modal top is clipped by 10px.
ui_bugs.selector: [role='dialog'] (DialogContent max-w-2xl on RoomsPage.js line 93 and ReservationsPage.js line 103)

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' - add DialogDescription for a11y

action_items: Actually apply the claimed fix: change className='max-w-2xl' to className='max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' on DialogContent in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/RoomsPage.js (line 93) AND /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/ReservationsPage.js (line 103). Current code does NOT contain the fix mentioned in the problem statement.
Optional: add <DialogDescription> to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Payload cleanup on RoomsPage save handler is NOT implemented as described - it still spreads the entire form (`...form`) so id/created_at/ical_token would still be sent when editing. Backend RoomIn seemingly ignores extra fields (no 422 observed), but the described 'hardening' was not applied.
Both admin dialog modals need max-h + overflow-y-auto to reliably scroll on shorter viewports.

success_rate.frontend: functional flows 100% at 1280x720; scroll-fix regression FAILED at <=700px height

seed_data_creation: Created + edited + deleted a test room 'Suíte Master Teste' end-to-end successfully. Cleanup completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The functional save/edit round-trip works: POST /api/rooms and PUT /api/rooms/{id} both succeed, toast 'Quarto salvo' shows, edit modal repopulates with correct values (name, category, daily_rate=350, rate_per_guest checkbox checked, amenities joined by comma), and updated daily_rate persists (card shows R$ 420). The Reservations 'Nova reserva' modal Save button is reachable at 1280x720 (bottom=695, viewport=720). The ONLY problem is the missing CSS scroll classes - once main agent actually adds 'max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' to both DialogContent instances, retest at viewport heights 600/720/900 to confirm internal scrolling works and Save is reachable in all cases.
rca of the issue: Root cause: main agent's summary said they added 'max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' to DialogContent on RoomsPage and ReservationsPage, but a code inspection of the current files shows only 'className="max-w-2xl"'. The claimed edit was never persisted. Reproduction: open /admin/rooms at viewport 1280x600, click Novo quarto - the modal renders 740px tall with the Salvar button below the visible viewport at y=609 (viewport ends at 600), and there is no internal scrollbar because computed overflowY is 'visible' and maxHeight is 'none'. Mitigation: apply the intended className change to lines 93 (RoomsPage) and 103 (ReservationsPage).
